description: This Java class 'ClientSheetPopulator' is responsible for populating an Excel sheet with client and office data, including mapping clients to offices, setting up the sheet layout, and creating various lookup maps for client IDs and savings accounts. It extends 'AbstractWorkbookPopulator' and interacts with Apache POI classes to manage Excel workbook content.

classes.name: ClientSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with client and office data, creating mappings and layout for importing client data.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to populate the given Workbook with client data on a sheet, setting layout, mappings, and protecting the sheet.

methods.name: setClientNameToClientIdMap
methods.description: Initializes a map from client display names to their IDs.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the header row and column widths in the worksheet.

methods.name: setOfficeToClientsMap
methods.description: Creates a mapping from office names to lists of client display names.

methods.name: setClientNameToSavingsAccountsIdsMap
methods.description: Creates a map from client display names to their savings account IDs.

methods.name: addToOfficeClientMap
methods.description: Adds a client to the list associated with an office in the mapping.

methods.name: populateClientsByOfficeName
methods.description: Fills the sheet with office names and their respective clients, recording start and end row indexes.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Returns the list of all clients.

methods.name: getClientsSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of clients.

methods.name: getOfficeNameToBeginEndIndexesOfClients
methods.description: Returns the mapping from office index to begin/end row indexes of clients.

methods.name: getClientNameToSavingsAccountIds
methods.description: Returns the map of client display names to their savings account IDs.
